extraction.scope: Every tracked source is inventoried. All non-static JavaScript files are parsed. Static test literals, declarations, other URL literals, parser comments, and the complete known oEmbed registry are retained separately.
exclusions: No upstream npm scripts, plugin functions, feeds, selectors, or getUrls callbacks run.
Static browser assets are inventoried by hash; their runtime is not copied.
The hosted QA domain allowlist is absent from the source tree and is not fetched.
Liveness and content suitability are not inferred from source presence.
